records.name: l10n_in.port.code.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="India Port Code">
                 <group>
                    <group>
                        <field name="name"/>
                        <field name="code"/>
                    </group>
                    <group>
                        <field name="state_id"/>
                    </group>
                </group>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: l10n_in.port.code.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="India Port Code">
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="code"/>
                <field name="state_id"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: l10n_in.port.code.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search string="India Port Code">
                <field name="name" string="Port" filter_domain="['|',('name', 'ilike', self),('code', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="state_id"/>
                <group>
                    <filter string="State" name="state" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'state_id'}"/>
                </group>
            </search>
        </field>
